_comment: #876 W1/W2: the nightly in-environment checks tools/nightly_verdicts.py bounds, and how often each ticks. The names are exactly what the data engine's lanes can record in mart.nightly_verdicts (their NIGHTLY_VERDICTS): common/runtime/tests/test_nightly_verdicts.py holds the two sets equal, so a check cannot be recorded and go unwatched. A verdict is stale past twice its cadence. A per_universe check names no universe: the tool expands it to check@lane_name over the universes that the contract of the same release schedules in some environment (environment_contract.v1.json, #1522). It is expected only in an environment whose contract schedules that universe (staging runs TOPT only, so it is not asked for a QQQ verdict). The tool reads THIS file as the deployed release's own copy (git show <release>:tools/nightly_verdicts.json), so a check added on main is not demanded of a release that does not run it yet. market_data_freshness ticks on weekdays only (cron 15 21 * * 1-5). Its largest gap is 72 hours, Friday to Monday, and the test test_every_declared_cadence_is_its_jobs_schedule_period holds the cadence equal to that gap. The 07:00 UTC read on a Monday is 57.75 hours after Friday's tick and stays green.
